inventory.other_executable_files: OpenSCAD rune-wheel geometry and display, not an LP2 decoding or scoring method

input_status: All four scripts embed the same 729 LP2-00–02 rune indices. Published continuations independently checked their match to site transcription, nine 29-entry mirror permutations, source output and fixed debug stops.
control_status: None of the four source programs supplies an encryption routine, a planted known-message recovery gate, a frozen complete-page scoring rule, or a held-out plaintext criterion. Published records explicitly identify this limit.
unresolved_extension: Running past fixed debug stops or searching alternate initial states/tables would require a newly specified method and positive control. It is not an untested executable branch of this pinned repository; source WIP fragments should not be counted as independent confirmations or failed complete decryptions.
disposition: All four pinned solving scripts have source-exact bounded replays. No further source-defined, control-ready LP2 search cohort was found in this repository revision. No new experiment record warranted.
